recap: Cavaliers beat the Rockets 135–130 in overtime.
Donovan Mitchell led the Cavaliers with 37 points (14-27 FG, 4-11 3PT), 1 rebounds and 6 assists.
Fred VanVleet led the Rockets with 27 points (9-19 FG, 4-8 3PT), 8 rebounds and 17 assists.
CLE won 3 of 4 factors: shooting, ball security, getting to the line. Effective FG% 58.9 to 52.0.
Biggest swing: Donovan Mitchell misses 20-foot pullup jump shot (Q4 1:04), −21 points of CLE win probability.
Best CLE lineup (4+ minutes): Mitchell, Strus, Allen, Merrill, Okoro, +6 in 4:32.
Bench points: CLE 48, HOU 46. Points in the paint: 50–60. Second-chance points: 26–20.
